user.title: Link with Mijn Energie
user.description: Create a pairing code for the home in the EL trading admin and enter it below. The code is valid for 1 hour.

data_description.code: 6 digits, for example 482913. Spaces are allowed.
data_description.url: Only change this for a test environment.

installation.title: Installation
installation.description: What installation does this home have? The next steps adapt to it. You can also set everything later in the portal.

p1.title: P1 meter
p1.description:
Linked to **{home}**.

P1 meter found: **{device}**. Check the sensors; the current value is shown in the picker.

data_description.p1_import: Import meter reading (T1 + T2), in kWh.
data_description.p1_export: Export meter reading (T1 + T2), in kWh.
data_description.gas: Gas meter reading in m³. Leave empty if there is no gas.
data_description.p1_invert: Turn on if this sensor shows a negative number while importing (e.g. GoodWe meter).

pv.title: Solar panels
pv.description: Choose the inverter's power and total yield. We already made a suggestion.

data_description.pv_power_1: What the panels produce now. W or kW; we convert.
data_description.pv_energy_1: Total yield since installation (not today or this year).

pv_hybrid.title: Solar panels
pv_hybrid.description: With a hybrid inverter, the inverter **output** is not what the panels produce: the battery sits in between. Choose the **PV power** (often 'input power' or 'PV power') and the **PV yield** of the panels.

data_description.pv_power_1: Power of the panels (input/DC), not the inverter output.
data_description.pv_energy_1: Total yield of the panels since installation, not the inverter's total output.

pv_multi.title: Solar panels (multiple inverters)
pv_multi.description: Enter PV power and total yield per inverter. We add them up. More than 3 inverters can be set in the portal.

data_description.pv_power_1: Power of the panels (input/DC), not the inverter output.
data_description.pv_energy_1: Total yield since installation (not today or this year).
data_description.pv_power_2: Power of the panels (input/DC), not the inverter output.
data_description.pv_energy_2: Total yield since installation (not today or this year).
data_description.pv_power_3: Power of the panels (input/DC), not the inverter output.
data_description.pv_energy_3: Total yield since installation (not today or this year).

battery.title: Battery
battery.description: Choose the battery's power and state of charge. With the charged/discharged counters, daily totals are most accurate. More batteries can be set in the portal.

data_description.battery_invert: Turn on if this sensor shows a positive number while discharging.
data_description.battery_soc: How full the battery is, in %.
data_description.battery_discharge: Increasing counter in kWh. Choose both counters or neither.

house.title: House consumption (optional)
house.description: Does the inverter have a house consumption sensor (e.g. 'load power')? The portal uses it as a check. House consumption itself is calculated: grid + solar − battery.

finish.title: Done
finish.description:
Linked with **{home}**. The first measurement and the sensor choice were sent to the portal.

Click Submit to finish.

finish_failed.title: Linked, but nothing sent yet
finish_failed.description:
Linked with **{home}**, but the test measurement did not reach the portal. The internet connection is probably down.

The integration keeps trying every minute; measurements and the sensor choice are sent once it succeeds. Click Submit to finish.

finish_portal.title: Sensor choice taken from the portal
finish_portal.description:
Linked with **{home}**. The portal already had a sensor choice (version {rev}); it was taken over. Change it in the portal or here via Configure.

Click Submit to finish.

reauth_confirm.title: Link again
reauth_confirm.description: The link with **{home}** needs to be renewed. Create a new pairing code for this home in the admin and enter it below. Queued measurements are kept.

data_description.code: 6 digits, for example 482913. Spaces are allowed.

error.invalid_code: This code has expired or was already used. Create a new code in the admin.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
error.cannot_connect: The portal cannot be reached. Check the internet connection of the HA Green.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.wrong_unit_power: This sensor is not a power sensor (expected W or kW).
error.wrong_unit_energy: This sensor is not an energy sensor (expected Wh, kWh or MWh).
error.wrong_unit_gas: This sensor is not a gas meter (expected m³).
error.wrong_unit_percent: This sensor is not a percentage.
error.not_a_total: This is an instantaneous value. Choose a sensor with an increasing meter reading.
error.same_entity: Import and export must be different sensors.
error.duplicate: This sensor is already chosen for another inverter.
error.both_counters: Choose both counters (charged and discharged) or neither.

abort.already_configured: This home is already linked on this Home Assistant. The link was renewed.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Mijn Energie is already linked. Use Configure on the integration to change something.
abort.reauth_successful: Linked again. Queued measurements are being sent now.
abort.wrong_home: This code belongs to a different home than {home}. Create the code for the right home.

init.description: The sensor choice is also managed in the portal (now version {rev}). If you change something here, it is sent to the portal within a minute.

entity_missing.title: Mijn Energie: sensor not found
entity_missing.description:
The sensor **{entity}** no longer exists, so this measurement is missing for {home}.

Choose another sensor in the portal (Meters and sensors) or via Settings › Devices & services › Mijn Energie › Configure.

no_connection.title: Mijn Energie: no connection
no_connection.description:
Since {since} the HA Green cannot reach the portal. {queue} measurements are waiting; they are sent automatically once the connection is back (up to 7 days).

Check the internet connection.
